name: ui-3d-reveal-vertical
title: 3D UI Reveal (vertical)
description: Vertical 3D UI reveal: the MatIntellect mark draws, the Figma window fits the 780 field on y 770, pushes in, tilts in 3D and flies away; the mark returns with a tagline and an address pill. Tagline, address, cues and exit are variables; holds or fades.
